evidenceType: Cooked counter sources and Blueprint qualification, plus static native frame grant and exact-class input activation

activationContract.grant: The game's DeflectComponent temporarily grants the received frame's existing CounterAbility class; the binding never grants abilities.
activationContract.nativeQualification: BP_PlayerPerfectDodge_Base requires a real current or nearest valid received frame. Special and paired-counter bases require frame.CounterAbility == this exact class.
activationContract.payload: Normal activation consumes the real frame handle and preserves source avatar, bullet, OnDodge and paired target execution setup.
activationContract.instancing: Normal native activation owns instancing; recipes do not locate an instance or call a stage endpoint.
